description: This PHP source file defines the ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController class, which extends the ViewLeaveEntitlementController. It handles rendering the 'view my leave entitlement' page for an employee, including setting up the component and permissions based on the authenticated user.

classes.name: ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: A controller responsible for managing the display of an employee's leave entitlements, extending base leave entitlement functionality and including permission management.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting leave types and periods, and setting user permissions based on the authenticated employee.
